deviations.what: t3's runner-side stdout capture only functions when the bridge holds an in-process artifact store; prod's sweep executes through the runner-service process on thor, which correctly holds no DB credentials — so on the real path the emitted count is captured but unreadable and h5 cannot be met live. Approved extension: the runner service uploads captured stdout through the existing attempt-scoped artifact PUT route using its per-operation callback token, and the API gains the read-back GET route. Operator-lane, ~2 commits, tests included.
deviations.reason: t3's boundary assumed runner-side capture suffices; the production dispatch path (runner-service, not in-process CodeRunner) was only established during the merge gate
